data.name: Hungering Blade
data.summary: A sentient greatsword from the Shadowfell waits in your camp chest, also in an existing save. It bites, feeds on kills, grows with your level and talks: 155 dark lines and 21 laughs above your head. Free, 15 languages, no Script Extender.

modfile.changelog: v1.2 – Last Course: a new action at the Feast stack limit (Action + Bonus Action). The blade eats every stack and screams: enemies within 9 m who fail a Wisdom saving throw are Frightened for 1 turn, and on a hit it bites like Bite or Hatred at full stacks. Bite now visibly drains its target and Hatred strikes with force. Fix: a kill finished by Cull the Weak after a blade hit now feeds the blade like any other kill. The voice add-on on Nexus Mods stays at 1.0.0 and works as before.

data.name: Vampiric Origins
data.summary: Introduces a playable Vampire Origin as well as an overhaul for Spawn Astarion and Ascendant Astarion. Includes the ability to sire spawn and elevate them to True Vampires. Tried to remain as faithful to lore as possible.

modfile.changelog:
A new passive is now granted after reading the *necromancy of thay*. It causes Vampire Bite and Ascendant Bite to deal an additional 3 necrotic damage. The damage modifier will appear in the tooltip’s damage list.

For players using the Vampire, Dhampir, or Astarion origin, the passive is granted immediately after reading the book. For other origins, it is granted when Ascended Astarion turns you into a vampire spawn, or when another vampire player turns you into a spawn in multiplayer.

If you read the book after already becoming a vampire spawn or true vampire, the passive will still be granted. Companion Astarion also receives it if you let him read the book.

You may notice that this upload skips a few version numbers. Those versions were used for testing.

If you’re playing as the Vampire, Dhampir, or Astarion origin and read the book before updating, reload a save from before you read it. This allows the script to grant the passive correctly.

data.name: Sura
data.summary: Powerful level 1-20 Sura class with sword combos, Ninja arts, stances, Willpower and Black Spirit Rage. Designed for solo play on the hardest difficulty. Includes Mistbound clothing. Levels 13-20 need a level-cap mod. No Script Extender needed

modfile.changelog:
**jodan & Legendary Equipment update**

- **jodan bonus** now performs a full main-hand weapon attack instead of a 1d4 strike. Costs one Bonus Action and no Willpower. Includes normal weapon modifiers, enchantment and on-hit effects. Still requires a qualifying hit in Jodan and is available once per turn.
- **mistbound Raiment, Kasa, Bracers, Footwraps and mantle** are now Legendary. Equipment growth follows total character level.
- **raiment** now provides base AC of 12 + Dexterity modifier + Wisdom modifier, alongside its existing level-based AC bonuses. Gains Slashing, Piercing and Bludgeoning resistance at level 11. Retains those resistances alongside flat 2 physical damage reduction at level 17.
- **kasa** now grants Alert at level 5, replacing its previous initiative bonus. Adds Perception proficiency and Expertise at level 11.
- **bracers** now grant +1/+2/+3 to attack rolls at levels 5/11/17. Fast Hands grants an additional Bonus Action from level 5.
- **footwraps** now grant +3/+5/+8 m movement at levels 5/11/17.
- **sura katana** now grants an additional Reaction while wielded in the main hand from level 5. Qualifying weapon hits and physical Sura cuts can also inflict Poisoned for two turns on a failed DC 13 Constitution save. Additional Sura Strike tails do not trigger this effect.

**new Legendary accessories**

- **mistbound Phantom band** grants +1/+2/+3/+4 Sleight of Hand at levels 1/5/11/17, plus Advantage on Stealth checks from level 11.
- **mistbound Trail band** grants +1/+2/+3/+4 Perception at levels 1/5/11/17 and ignores Difficult Terrain’s movement penalty from level 11.
- **mistbound Spirit seal** grants +2/+4/+6/+8 maximum HP at levels 1/5/11/17, Psychic resistance from level 5 and Frightened immunity from level 17.

New accessories are included in newly created Sura characters’ starting equipment. They are not automatically added to existing characters.

**fixes**

- Corrected equipment resistance application for the Raiment, Spirit Seal and Mantle.
- Prevented equipment-granted Alert and Fast Hands from duplicating their existing native features.
- Updated affected descriptions.
